params.prompt:
Create a polished ORIGINAL CREATURE CONCEPT ATLAS for Riptide, a hand-painted fantasy chibi RPG. This is a visual breeding catalogue: every requested cell is ONE NEW hybrid creature, visibly inheriting anatomical traits from BOTH named parents. Reference images show the existing parent species and exact visual style; use their painted shapes and palette, never copy the reference atlas layout.
EXACT OUTPUT LAYOUT: landscape 3:2 image, an INVISIBLE uniform grid of FIVE equal columns by THREE equal rows. EXACTLY FIFTEEN separate complete creatures. Read the assignments in row-major order: row1 left-to-right cells01-05, row2 cells06-10, row3 cells11-15. Each creature occupies only its own cell and stays centered with at least 20 percent transparent clearance on EVERY side. Entire tails, horns, antlers, paws and wings must fit within that cell. No extras, no empty cells, no overlap. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND outside the silhouettes. No scene, no terrain, no white matte, no checkerboard, no visible grid, NO LETTERING or labels or numbers. Labels will be added by code.
STYLE: match the supplied original Riptide Tides: beautiful hand-painted storybook fantasy sprites, bold clean dark-brown ink outlines, warm modeled painterly highlights, detailed fur/feathers/scales, large expressive heads, short sturdy chibi proportions, powerful readable silhouettes, cool mutated fantasy animals. A range of charming to fierce, no gore. Full-body three-quarter SIDE VIEW, head facing RIGHT, tail left; anatomically connected single head/body, grounded feet or a clearly intentional floating pose. Restrained magical body highlights, no huge glow clouds or floor shadows. Six-limbed fantasy creatures only where a specified wing pair or insect anatomy needs it. Balanced inheritance, not an original animal simply recolored.

STRICT PLACEMENT: Creature centers are at x=10%,30%,50%,70%,90% of the image and y=16.67%,50%,83.33%. Each creature including every appendage fits within just 60% of its own cell width and 70% of its own cell height. Transparent gutters between every pair of neighbors are essential. Do not enlarge a creature to fill its entire cell. Match these fifteen independent center points precisely.

CELL 01 (row 1, column 1): Thorn Badger + Obsidian Bear. Create a bear towering shoulder hump and huge front paws with a badger low elongated rear torso and striped pointed muzzle. Its foreclaws are broad digging blades rather than thin talons. Emerald thorns grow through seams in natural obsidian back armor, contrasting with dense charcoal fur and small round ears.
CELL 02 (row 1, column 2): Thorn Badger + Aurora Kirin. Give a badger sturdy digging chest, broad claws and striped muzzle an arched kirin neck with a pearly horn. Hindfeet become neat cloven hooves beneath grey fur. Lilac scales and emerald thorns alternate along the shoulder ridge, while mint-pink mane strands and a long silky tail soften the powerful silhouette.
CELL 03 (row 1, column 3): Thorn Badger + Spectral Panther. Make a low spectral panther with a badger broad digging shoulders, shovel claws and cream-striped elongated face. Its rear torso remains sleek and feline, ending in a long curved tail. Emerald thorn ridges emerge through translucent sapphire fur, with bright cyan edges defining the thick paws and narrow watchful eyes.
CELL 04 (row 1, column 4): Thorn Badger + Spectral Wyrm. Combine a badger low heavy chest and four digging paws with an elongated spectral dragon neck and curled scaled tail. A cream-striped tapered muzzle blends into one horned dragon face. Emerald shoulder thorns become sapphire dorsal fins along the neck and tail, retaining dense grey fur around the powerful forearms.
CELL 05 (row 1, column 5): Cinder Wolf + Frost Ibex. Fuse a wolf long fanged muzzle, pointed ears and springy forepaws with an ibex compact chest, swept ice horns and cloven rear hooves. A short white beard grows beneath the canine jaw. Ember mane tufts curl around blue horn bases and continue down charcoal shoulders into frosted goat wool.
CELL 06 (row 2, column 1): Cinder Wolf + Rune Stag. Combine a wolf fanged long muzzle and muscular forelegs with a stag high arched neck, branching wooden antlers and cloven rear feet. Cream throat fur flows into a red ember mane. Mint runes cross chestnut-charcoal flanks beneath raised shoulder fur, and the full brush tail remains distinctly canine.
CELL 07 (row 2, column 2): Cinder Wolf + Coral Drake. Build a lean wolf with pointed ears, long fanged muzzle and powerful paws, then extend its spine into a curled coral dragon tail. Small teal membrane wings attach behind the ember mane. Coral hornlets and cheek fins emerge through charcoal face fur, with scaled plates protecting the shoulders and thighs.
CELL 08 (row 2, column 3): Cinder Wolf + Dawn Phoenix. Fuse a wolf lean torso, long fanged muzzle and canine hindpaws with feathered phoenix forelegs ending in golden talons. Broad orange-gold wings rise behind an ember neck crest. A small hooked beak ridge blends into the upper jaw, while the full wolf brush tail opens into curved flame plumes.
CELL 09 (row 2, column 4): Cinder Wolf + Obsidian Bear. Create a bear massive shoulder hump and heavy clawed front paws joined to a wolf lean rear torso, long jaw and full brush tail. Ember mane fur grows between obsidian shoulder slabs. Round bear cheek volume merges with pointed canine ears, giving one powerful snarling head above planted charcoal forelegs.
CELL 10 (row 2, column 5): Cinder Wolf + Aurora Kirin. Combine a wolf long canine muzzle, strong forepaws and alert ears with a kirin arched neck, pearly horn and cloven rear feet. Lilac scales emerge beneath charcoal fur along the flanks. Its ember mane transitions into mint-pink flowing strands, while the long brush tail carries a silky aurora tip.
CELL 11 (row 3, column 1): Cinder Wolf + Spectral Panther. Give a spectral panther low muscular torso and curved feline tail a wolf long fanged muzzle, pointed ears and powerful canine forelegs. A raised ember mane follows the neck and shoulder line. Charcoal hair transitions into translucent sapphire flank fur, while broad feline hindpaws and narrow blue eyes define its stalking stance.
CELL 12 (row 3, column 2): Cinder Wolf + Spectral Wyrm. Fuse a wolf four powerful legs and lean chest with an elongated spectral dragon neck and complete coiled tail. The single horned head combines a canine long jaw and silver dragon horns. Charcoal fur and an ember neck crest grade into sapphire scales, with cyan fins continuing along the sinuous spine.
CELL 13 (row 3, column 3): Frost Ibex + Sunmane. Combine a lion broad chest, golden mane and heavy padded forepaws with an ibex swept ice horns, white beard and cloven hindhooves. A compact goat barrel supports the large feline shoulders. Golden mane layers frame the blue horn roots, and the long tufted lion tail contrasts with frosted flank wool.
CELL 14 (row 3, column 4): Frost Ibex + Rune Stag. Create a strong mountain deer with an ibex stocky chest, beard and four broad cloven hooves. Its horns sweep backward like icy goat horns before branching into wooden stag tines, one continuous organic structure. White wool meets chestnut flanks carrying mint rune grooves, with crystal ridges along the shoulders.
CELL 15 (row 3, column 5): Frost Ibex + Coral Drake. Fuse an ibex barrel body, white beard and swept ice horns with a coral drake fanged muzzle, teal membrane wings and curled scaled tail. Four sturdy legs end in split hooflike dragon claws. White wool transitions into coral shoulder scales, and sea-green cheek fins fan behind the icy horn roots.
